actual: The New Class wizard's 'Save draft' did NOT refuse a second blank-suffix class: the dialog closed, toast 'Draft saved', and a second blank-suffix draft appeared ('U12 Batting Foundations', Draft, 0/12, no dates) even though a live blank-suffix class already existed and the Schedule step showed the field [invalid] with 'Another U12 Batting Foundations class already uses just the program name. Add a suffix.' The rule IS enforced elsewhere: completing that draft in Edit, Assign coach did NOT advance (field invalid, same duplicate warning), and Edit's Save draft also refused. So only one LIVE blank-suffix class exists; the loophole is specific to the New Class wizard's Save draft. The optional third check (cancel the live blank class, retry blank) was not done — no plain Cancel is offered for the live class (Actions: View roster, View sessions, Rename, Archive, Revert to draft); Archive/Revert were not used.
expected: Saving a second class with a blank suffix is refused as the name is already taken.
steps: Add a class to 'U12 Batting Foundations' and clear the suffix field. Read the help line.
title: PRG-030: New Class wizard Save draft does not refuse a second blank-suffix class — duplicate draft is created
